column1: # resign-2026-08-17.tsv — old SHA -> new SHA, for the re-signing rewrite of 2026-08-17.
# Two commits from 2026-08-15 (d0ce6d17, 438b3124) were never GPG-signed, and the
# pre-push hook refuses unsigned commits toward Radicle canonical. Re-signing them
# rewrote every descendant: 208 commits from da0ca195 (exclusive) to the tip, which
# became 8c00e9b0. Content is unchanged — each pair was checked to have an identical
# tree hash and subject, 208 of 208 — so this maps names, not versions.
# Anything written before that date which cites a commit by SHA (a memory note, a
# doc, an issue, a code comment) points at a commit that no longer exists. Look it up:
# Columns: old-sha <TAB> new-sha <TAB> subject.  Oldest first.
# History BELOW da0ca195 (2026-07-01 and earlier) is untouched by this rewrite and
# remains unsigned; an earlier rewrite on 2026-07-01 has no mapping recorded, which
# is the reason this file exists.
